Walkable Street Network of Arequipa (Historic Center / Yanahuara)

Source: R/data.R
streets_arequipa.Rd

A spatial sf line dataset representing the walkable street network of the Historic Center, Plaza de Armas, and Yanahuara in Arequipa, Peru. Extracted from OpenStreetMap and projected into UTM Zone 19S (EPSG:32719).

Usage

streets_arequipa

Format

An sf data frame with LINESTRING geometries and columns:

street_id

Unique integer identifier for each street segment.

osm_id

Original OpenStreetMap way identifier.

name

Street or passage name (if available).

highway

OpenStreetMap road classification (e.g. pedestrian, footway, residential, tertiary).

oneway

Directionality tag from OSM.

surface

Pavement surface type.

geom

LineString geometry in EPSG:32719.

Source

OpenStreetMap contributors (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright), ODbL 1.0.

Examples

data(streets_arequipa)
nrow(streets_arequipa)
#> [1] 519
